title: Clean-Span Relief Rate by Level and Violation Count (Seller Performance Standing)
content:
**Rate schedule.** The clean-span relief rate of a Seller Performance Standing seller is 0.3 (30%) for a seller placed at Above Standard Level with at most three policy violations recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months, and 0.25 (25%) for a seller placed at Standard Level with at most three policy violations recorded in that period. For a seller placed at a lower level, or with four or more policy violations recorded in that period, neither of these rates applies.

## Counting the twelve months

Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the last twelve whole calendar months when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from the date it was recorded to the handling date. Every policy violation recorded in that period counts, of whatever type, whether or not its points have since been reversed, expired or relieved.

| Hypothetical handling date | Violation recorded on | Whole months passed | In the last twelve? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 September | 16 September of the previous year | 11 | yes |
| 15 September | 15 September of the previous year | 12 | no |

## Schedule

| Level the seller is placed at | Violations recorded in the last twelve whole calendar months | Clean-span relief rate |
|---|---|---|
| Above Standard Level | 0 to 3 | 0.3 |
| Above Standard Level | 4 or more | neither rate in this schedule |
| Standard Level | 0 to 3 | 0.25 |
| Standard Level | 4 or more | neither rate in this schedule |
| Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level | any number | neither rate in this schedule |

## Both sides of the count

- An Above Standard Level seller with exactly three violations recorded in the period: 0.3. With four: the 0.3 rate does not apply.
- A Standard Level seller with exactly three violations in the period: 0.25. With four: the 0.25 rate does not apply.
- A violation recorded thirteen whole months before the handling date is outside the period and does not enter the count.
